ada: Heads up — running into a weird one while switching org profiles.

I have two profiles: `personal` and `acme`. I do `redwoodctl auth login --profile acme` then start `redwood local-serve --profile acme` and it works. If I later `redwoodctl auth login --profile personal` and then run `redwood local-serve --profile personal` the server still uses the acme tokens and I get 401s.

leo: Oof. Can you paste `redwoodctl auth status --profile personal --debug` and `ls -la ~/.redwood`?

ada: Debug output:```
DEBUG: profile=personal
INFO: reading token cache /home/ada/.redwood/token_cache.json
INFO: token found -> expires 2026-08-01T12:34:56Z
INFO: using token for org acme (cached_org=acme)
```
ls: `-rw-r--r-- 1 ada ada 432 /home/ada/.redwood/token_cache.json`

kim: I think this is the cache-keying bug we patched for tokens but not for local-serve. token_cache.json still stores a single "last_active_org" field and local-serve reads that instead of honoring `--profile`.

ada: Workaround for now: `REDWOOD_PROFILE=personal redwood local-serve` worked for me after deleting token_cache.json. But that's annoying during quick dev loops.

leo: Can you show the token_cache.json (redact tokens) so we can confirm format?

ada:```
{
  "last_active_org": "acme",
  "tokens": {
    "acme": { "access_token": "...", "expires_at": 1710000000 },
    "personal": { "access_token": "...", "expires_at": 1700000000 }
  }
}
```

kim: Yep — local-serve is currently reading `last_active_org` first and shortcutting profile resolution. That's a bug: it should check `--profile` or REDWOOD_PROFILE env var first, then fall back to the cache. I'll open a bug.

ada: Filing note: reproduces on Linux (Ubuntu), macOS, WSL. Not tried on Hosted Windows terminal yet.

leo: Temporary patch we can push to dev images: set `REDWOOD_FORCE_PROFILE=true` in the local-serve wrapper so it always honors `--profile`. Also add a note to the docs about token_cache being safe to remove.

kim: Filed DEVEX-7821: local-serve ignores --profile when token_cache.last_active_org present. Assigning @eng-runtime. Repro steps and logs attached.

devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-7821 and linked to eng-runtime backlog. :white_check_mark:
